rule.name: in-image slot target resolution (target claim, not an ABI contract)
applies_when: the site's function fragment and field offset match an EDGE_TARGET_SLOTS entry (or the site is the entry's register/stack edge);
every named target symbol resolves to a function start in this exact image;
for a function writer, every writer symbol is defined and reachable in the pre-closure;
for a static initialiser, every target is the first qword of an in-image data table (names matching _HW/HW_).
not_applied_when: no reachability evidence was supplied (reachable is None);
a declared target or writer is absent from this image;
the writer is defined but not reachable in the pre-closure;
the slot is filled from an externally supplied callback.
rule.effect: site['unresolved'] becomes false with class 'in-image-slot'; the site adds exactly the resolved target addresses, not the residual field-store union, so the closure's upper bound is narrowed only where the writer and every target are established.
rule.witness_isolation: this rule never sets ABI_CONTRACT_PROVIDER or ABI_CONTRACT_ALLOCATOR, is not in ABI_CONTRACT_CLASSES, and does not touch provider_contract_witness or allocator_contract_witness.
